judge_input.description:
#### Please, if you would be so kind, go right ahead and describe each and every one of the changes that happen to be contained inside of your PR here. If it should turn out to be the case that it is one which is addressing an issue of some sort, then please make a point of going ahead and referencing that particular issue as well while you are about it.

The situation that we had on our hands here was a trickle of pull requests that kept on coming in from the community side of things, and each and every one of those particular pull requests was one that went ahead and found issues of its own:
- LLM: https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/3422
- STT: https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/pull/3351

What this particular one right here goes ahead and does is that it takes that very same fix and applies it, and the places that it applies that same fix to are TTS on the one hand, OpenAI Realtime on another, and then Gemini Live as well on top of those.

Then, over and above all of that, the changelogs are also ones that are getting themselves updated here too, and the whole reason for doing that is so that they all end up being consistent with one another.

@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- Fixed an issue in `traced_stt` where `model_name` in OpenTelemetry appears as `unknown`.
